"FOSS can be freely used, modified and distributed. Copyright protects the expression of an idea, not the idea itself. Using pirated software is a violation of copyright. Plagiarism can be avoided by giving credit to the original source."
(i) Explain the term 'patent', which is related to the theme of the extract. (1)
(ii) Using the extract and your own knowledge, explain the following: Students should cite sources in projects. (1)
(iii) A student concludes: "Plagiarism is allowed if the source is on the Internet." Use your knowledge of the chapter to evaluate this conclusion. (2)
items.answer: (i) The exclusive right granted to an inventor over an invention, usually for 20 years. (ii) Presenting others' work without credit is plagiarism. (iii) The conclusion is wrong: Using others' work without credit is plagiarism wherever it comes from.
items.markingKey: 1+1+2 marks: (i) The exclusive right granted to an inventor over an invention, usually for 20 years. (ii) Presenting others' work without credit is plagiarism. (iii) The conclusion is wrong: Using others' work without credit is plagiarism wherever it comes from.

items.stem:
Read the following statements about e-waste management and health concerns:
I. Taking regular breaks from screens reduces eye strain.
II. Using devices for long hours has no effect on health.
III. E-waste contains toxic materials such as lead, mercury and cadmium.
Which of these statements are correct?
items.answer: I and III only
items.markingKey: (d) I is correct. II is incorrect: It can cause eye strain, back pain and sleep problems. III is correct.
options: III only
II and III only
II only
I and III only

items.answer: Ethical – with permission, to find and fix weaknesses (white hat); unethical – unauthorised, for harm or gain (black hat).
